sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.status: normative Recommendation; source identity reused from round-01
sources.fact: Reflow preserves information/functionality at 320 CSS px width for vertical scrolling or 256 CSS px height for horizontal scrolling; necessary two-dimensional parts excepted. Target minimum is 24×24 CSS px, subject to named exceptions. Resize Text requires 200% without loss (except captions/images of text). Meaningful reading sequence must be programmatically determinable. Keyboard focus must not be entirely hidden by author-created content.
sources.inference: Overflow absence alone cannot establish content retention. Geometry does not establish keyboard, sequence, text resize, or full-page conformance.
exception: in-sentence or non-target line-height constrained inline
sources.duplicate_policy: No second fetch/download of existing WCAG22 source; new sections read through normative link.

sources.title: Understanding SC 1.4.10: Reflow
sources.status: informative explanation; not a normative requirement
sources.fact: Relocating or collapsing content is allowed if still accessible. Exceptions stay local; cells generally reflow. Page-level two-dimensional scrolling can pass when caused by excepted content and non-excepted content reflows. Local containment is preferable. 1280-width at 400% corresponds to 320 CSS px; actual viewport matters.
sources.inference: A checker may enforce a stricter local-container project policy, but must not call every page-level overflow a WCAG failure. Required information hidden with no reachable alternative fails the retention condition.
sources.exception: Table exception does not automatically cover individual cells, adjacent prose, pagination, or actions.

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.5.8: Target Size (Minimum)
sources.status: informative explanation/examples; normative SC restated separately
section: Key Terms: target, minimum bounding box, essential
sources.fact: Size requires an axis-aligned 24×24 square entirely inside the target. Spacing circles have diameter 24 and use bounding-box centers, including concave shapes. Examples pass 20×20 targets with 4px gaps, and a 16×16 target with 4px gap from a large target. Overlap is excluded from target-size measurement unless targets perform the same action/open the same page.
sources.inference: The examples support accepting tangency in the corresponding geometry model. A bounding rectangle cannot establish an inscribed square or the effective area after clipping. The target is the actual pointer-action area.
sources.exception: Underlying temporarily obscured targets are not evaluated while obscured by interaction/scripted content; new overlaid controls remain subject. This is not a general permission to obscure controls.

sources.title: Understanding SC 1.4.4: Resize Text
sources.status: informative; normative criterion restated at SC section
sources.fact: Text can be resized without assistive technology up to 200% without loss of content/functionality, except captions and images of text.
sources.inference: A narrow-layout or reflow result is not evidence that actual text can reach 200%.

geometry_contract.supported_input: Finite CSS-pixel coordinates of confirmed axis-aligned filled rectangular effective pointer target areas, same viewport/state/coordinate system; complete adjacent target inventory; no unresolved clipping/overlap/transforms; evidence provenance required.

size.scope: Only supported filled effective rectangles. Exact 24 passes; either dimension below 24 is undersized. No rounding-up.

spacing.circle_rectangle: For each undersized i and every other actual target j, dx=max(x_j-cx_i,0,cx_i-(x_j+w_j)); dy=max(y_j-cy_i,0,cy_i-(y_j+h_j)); conflict if dx^2+dy^2 < 144.
spacing.boundary: Tangency equality accepted in this bounded model, derived from Understanding Figures 5 and 10; not a separately stated normative inequality.
spacing.must_check_both: Circle-circle checks alone miss wide/short targets. Circle-versus-actual-target required even when the other target is itself undersized.
spacing.not_required: A genuinely size-passing target does not need spacing merely because adjacent targets exist; undersized neighbor must still pass its own checks.
spacing.precision: No WCAG epsilon found. Do not fabricate 0.5px/1px tolerances or round 23.999 up. Measurement uncertainty should produce HOLD.

exceptions.spacing: Requires geometry evidence, not Boolean claim.
exceptions.equivalent: Different identified control on same page; same function; criterion satisfied. Cyclic or mutually unsupported exemption assertions do not prove satisfaction.
exceptions.inline: Actual sentence participation or size constrained by non-target text line-height; CSS display:inline, list membership, or a text label alone is insufficient evidence.
exceptions.user_agent: UA controls target size and author has not modified it; native tag alone insufficient.
exceptions.essential: Specific presentation essential to conveyed information/functionality, or legally required; document actual reason. Product preference or density preference alone insufficient.

geometry_contract.output_scope: Geometry relation only; never generic accessibility PASS or rendered WCAG conformance.

reflow_contract.boundary: For vertically scrolling horizontal-writing content, actual equivalent width 320 CSS px. Horizontal-scrolling vertical-writing case uses height 256. 400% is a corresponding setup from 1280/1024, not an independent universal viewport size.
reflow_contract.retention: Map required information and actions to their accessible location at the boundary. Collapse/reposition may satisfy retention; removing, clipping, or display:none with no reachable alternative does not.
reflow_contract.exception_scope: Identify specific part and reason two-dimensional layout is necessary for usage/meaning. Reject page-wide inheritance to unrelated prose/actions. Check individual table cells independently unless separately excepted.
reflow_contract.overflow: Page overflow metric is a diagnostic, not a complete conformance oracle. A local scroll container is recommended; page overflow solely due to an excepted item can still satisfy SC if all non-excepted content reflows.
reflow_contract.related_checks: Keep 200% text enlargement, meaningful sequence, and focus-not-entirely-obscured as distinct checks; this geometry model establishes none.
